name: 1Password
description: Sign in to websites with saved logins and one-time codes from your 1Password vaults, through the 1Password CLI and a read-only service account.
installationSteps: On 1Password.com, open Developer → Service Accounts and create a service account with read-only access to the vaults to share. Built-in Personal, Private, and Employee vaults cannot be shared with service accounts.
Install this plugin, then ask a Bot to set up 1Password. It installs the CLI and asks for the service account token through a secure input.
Bots then sign in to websites with matching saved logins and one-time codes when a task needs them.
Uninstalling removes the skill only. Remove the OP_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_TOKEN secret, or revoke the service account at 1Password, to end access.
